tools.note: AEO uses the purpose-scoped reporting key first and a distinct held private-app credential only as a read-only fallback after legacy traffic analytics returns 401 or 403. Runs 36774252259, 36776010659, 36776831844, and 36777936249 proved aggregate contacts, traffic, forms, marketing events, meetings, and booking authorities without exporting contact rows. The seven-day synthesis returned 44,090 tracked visits and 1,756 created contacts; the 90-day synthesis returned 554,976 tracked visits, 21,904 created contacts, 2,273 governed bookings, and 71 public-website events. Ninety-day contact-source detail exceeded the 10,000-row safe cap and is explicitly labeled partial. Read-only authority inspection also found hs_meeting_created_from_link_id on governed bookings and externalEventId or eventUrl on Marketing Events; these are non-personal reconciliation candidates, not approved join keys. HubSpot tracked traffic covers every portal-tracked domain unless a HubSpot analytics view narrows it; page-level alpha.school paths remain GA4 territory.

tools.name: Alpha site observer (superbuilders/aeo)
answers: measurement access, tag, linker, freshness, key-event and anomaly health
tools.note: The site observer measures rendered conformance. Its separate read-only measurement-integrity workflow runs daily/on demand from the playbook contract. AEO run 36909740628 passed against production credentials and proved GA4 freshness, recent governed starts, the registered event-scoped destination_key definition, both aggregate HubSpot authorities, legacy traffic aggregates through the bounded fallback, a real Search Console query, and live GTM version 7. Contract 1.0 keeps definition, processed population, and authority reconciliation as separate checks. Destination-key population is still processing; destination continuity, controlled reconciliation, Community coverage, and outcome joins remain blocked or degraded.

tools.name: Alpha Website as a Funnel synthesis
answers: weekly and 90-day traffic and acquisition baselines
CTA starts by page, channel, and device
privacy-safe search-intent clusters with clicks, impressions, CTR, and landing pages
HubSpot form views and submissions joined to the current form catalog and grouped by diagnostic purpose
campus-page traffic, search demand, and CTA starts joined to public HubSpot Program lifecycle
tools.note: Aggregate-only and privacy-safe. It never divides GA4 sessions by HubSpot contacts, promotes a click or form submission to a conversion, exports a person, or configures a GA4 key event. Run 36910071665 reports destination-key definition, processed population, and candidate reconciliation separately; newly registered population remains degraded at zero without weakening the completion boundary. It labels partial CTA-start coverage, capped HubSpot contact-source detail, and capped Search Console rows. Form purposes are name-based diagnostics across all portal-tracked domains. Campus demand includes only Open and Announced Programs with a non-root alpha.school route; excluded source rows and duplicate routes remain visible. The aggregate GA4 Data API does not expose exits or ordered user paths; those require an approved BigQuery export.
